description: A distribution producer must authorize the digital release package for a live-concert documentary and set its territory, runtime, credits, and required delivery actions.

shared_context.S1: The live-concert documentary is currently assembled at 68 minutes.
shared_context.S2: The streaming platform has requested a worldwide 68-minute master for delivery on Friday.
shared_context.S3: The documentary has not yet been publicly released.
shared_context.S4: At the package-lock meeting, Nadia reviews the release territory, running time, credits, and approval requirements with the responsible production leads before authorizing delivery.

PF1.text: Leon reviewed the executed music license this morning and confirmed that the featured song permits digital streaming only in the United States and Canada; the license also requires a cue sheet to be delivered with the authorized master, but he has not entered those limits in the release tracker.

PF2.text: Maya checked the archive-footage license exhibit with the post house today and confirmed that the finished program may not exceed exactly 52 minutes; the current 68-minute assembly therefore cannot be delivered under the existing footage license, and she has not yet updated the runtime sheet.

PF3.text: Rafael confirmed with the lead artist's representative this afternoon that the artist's release requires written approval of the final picture before distribution and specifies the end-card wording exactly as 'Featuring the Live Performance of Marisol Vega'; neither item has been added to the delivery checklist.

acceptance_conditions: The release must not be authorized for the worldwide territory requested by the platform.
The release territory must be limited to the territories permitted by the music license.
The delivered program must be exactly 52 minutes long.
The end card must use the artist's specified wording exactly.
A cue sheet delivery commitment must be logged.
A written final-picture approval outreach commitment must be logged.

content_checks.C4: decisions['end_card_credit'] == 'Featuring the Live Performance of Marisol Vega'
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'deliverable_preparation' and 'cue sheet' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'approval_outreach' and c['target'] == 'Rafael' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The license's United States-and-Canada limit changes the release from the requested worldwide authorization, requires the release to remain unauthorized for worldwide delivery, and adds the cue-sheet commitment.
The archive-footage license changes the deliverable runtime from the shared 68-minute assembly to exactly 52 minutes and prevents authorization of the noncompliant 68-minute package.

The artist release changes the end-card text to the exact Marisol Vega wording, requires written final-picture approval outreach, and prevents authorization before that approval requirement is addressed.
